integrity: The cycle chain has coefficients plus or minus one on disjoint ring supports, so the construction does not rely on rescaling a single class representative.
The cut lower bound and LP feasible solution are proved analytically for every integer m at least 2.
The included verifier checks the explicit cochain formula for m from 2 through 10; these finite checks are not used as proof of the all-m theorem.
scientific_limitations: The construction is a finite planar simplicial complex and need not be a 2-manifold at the wedge vertex.
The result concerns the unweighted sum-of-absolute-values relaxation of the minimum homological edge-cut support problem; it does not classify stronger relaxations or restricted manifold subclasses.
The LP bound is an explicit feasible upper bound, not a claim of exact LP optimality.
title: An unbounded LP gap for homological edge cuts on planar annulus wedges
